findings.summary: Guardian concept categories, timestamps and sentence emphasis remain 14px, below the project’s required 18px text size.
findings.fix: Extend the guardian-only workspace typography rule to .concept-meta b, .concept-meta time and .sentence > em (or include b, time and em) with font-size:1.125rem; preserve student styling.
findings.evidence: At 320/390/1280, computed .concept-meta b and time and .sentence > em are 14px. The selector at line 183 omits b/time/em; styles.css:798 and :490 set 0.875rem. Runtime: .a11y-history/final-audit/visual-runtime-evidence.json, passage320/passage390/passage1280.

passed: Independent headless Chrome/Puppeteer runtime on HEAD 48b3ac1 using port 8894 and disposable accounts; no provider requests permitted.
Measured visible text foreground/background combinations in intro, fully expanded guide, guardian dashboard, all wizard steps and all six result panels: no WCAG 1.4.3 contrast failures.
All tested interactive controls have visible 4px keyboard focus outlines; ring #8c4700 contrasted with white/canvas/amber-soft backgrounds. Detailed computed styles in visual-focus-evidence.json.
Intro, guide, guardian dashboard, wizard steps and result panels reflow without measured horizontal overflow at 320, 390 and 1280 CSS px.
Guardian flow and intro/guide button elements meet 48px minimum height; 24px native checkbox visuals have associated text labels.
Reduced-motion preference produced no visible animations or transitions in guardian results.
notes: The 18px finding is a stricter RESKIN_PLAYBOOK section 6 requirement, not a WCAG minimum-font-size failure.
Audit date 2026-11-05; Puppeteer 25.16.0, local Google Chrome; read-only product audit, only disposable account data and audit artifacts created.
Login’s existing 14–16px typography and 44px voice-test control were observed but excluded from findings because the redesign permits only one added login link.
